page.layout: Top: a printed rule and a decorative woodcut ornament. Below, a heading in spaced capitals. Then one column of alphabetical index entries beside a large initial A, running off the right edge of the scan.; One page, cut into strips. This strip shows the right-hand part of a centred title block with an ornamental woodcut frame above it, then a column of index lines with page numbers, ending with a gathering signature at the foot. No margins with text.; One column of index entries in the centre-right of the page, under a title in capitals at the top; a letter "A" heads the column. The top of the page holds an ornamental border (not text). No running head, page number, catchword or signature is printed.

page.notes: The strip is cut at its left and right edges, so the index lines begin and end in mid-word. The first lines are fragments of the title block. The signature "Qqq" is printed at the foot of this strip. Left-edge fragments of numbers and marks are not legible enough to transcribe. Several entries are read with some doubt: "abscessus" (printed form hard to separate from "abscellus"), "abrasio" (printed with a long-s form), and the spacing of several page-number lists. The bottom of the page is blurred and has no legible text.
